thread:
Anya: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick thread to capture Qs and follow-ups about the customer wins/losses segment.

Matt: Quick q — with the three losses we called out, was pricing the main reason? or integration complexity?

Erica: Pricing was called out in 2 of 3, but integration + data residency was the closer for the enterprise deal. We need to be clearer on Private deployment timelines.

Sam: For roadmap clarity — timeline for VPC private GA? We said "H2" on the slide but need more precise.

Erica: We're targeting end of Q3 for VPC GA for small/medium setups; full on-prem GA will be phased and we plan to announce beta by mid-Q4.

Katie: Any ask from sales for immediate materials? Customers want a one-pager that compares Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for procurement teams.

Anya: Agreed — I'll spin up a one-pager and template RFP answers. Assigning to @Anya, expect draft by Friday.

Lee: On the technical side: the bigger win trend was suffix caching + batching improvements — shipping that tuned model config reduced latency for a few customers.

Julian: Also worth noting we proactively suggested a quantized variant for one customer which cut costs and sealed the deal.

Matt: For losses, one customer flagged "no HSM/KMS integration" as a blocker. Is that on the roadmap?

Sam: KMS/HSM integrations are prioritized for Private deployments; timeline TBD — CTO and infra team are scoping now.

deploy-bot: New RFC created: private-kms-integration (#278). Link: https://go/repo/rfc/278

Erica: Action items: 1) one-pager (Anya) 2) RFP template (Sam & Katie) 3) KMS RFC review (Infra) 4) Showcases for suffix-cache perf (Eng-ML).

Matt: Can we also have a short FAQ for CS to respond to "why we chose model X"? They were getting different answers.

Anya: On it — will pull excerpts from the evals and a tl;dr. Any volunteers to review? @Lee @Julian?

Lee: I'll review.

Julian: Happy to help, will add perf notes.

Erica: Thanks all. If you need headcount for sustained RFP work, ping me offline. :thumbsup: 

Sam: Noted — will loop PM on resource asks.

Anya: Closing thread — I'll post the one-pager draft in #docs by Thursday and tag reviewers.

Katie: Thanks! :clap: 

Matt: Top-level note: let's track these action items in the customer success board so we can measure improvement.

Erica: Agreed — assign a lead and we'll review progress in next all-hands.
